_about: The owner's standing decisions on sales records, applied to public/data/sf-listings.geojson by scripts/apply-sale-decisions.mjs on every data refresh (geocode-listings.mjs runs it after validation). Sales in "confirmed" are ones the owner checked: the review stops questioning their price or type (E4, E7b, E7c, E8, R2, R4). "remove" takes out a record that is not a home sale. Records left out are listed in data/removed-sales.csv, corrected records in data/edited-sales.csv, and reports/market/review.py shows both every month. The reporting period end is data/reporting-period.json.
